name: RACV Cape Schanck Golf Course
address: Trent Jones Dr, Cape Schanck VIC 3939
editorNote: RACV Cape Schanck has an 18-hole, par-70 course designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr. Tree-lined fairways, large bunkers and elevated tee positions with ocean views make it a different round from the nearby links courses. Resort accommodation and practice areas are on site. RACV lists both member and standard green fees; online tee-time booking requires registration.
